items.tier: primary-religious-text (scriptural narrative; the event is not independently verified)
items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
items.claim: The text says that when Moses stretched his rod toward heaven, the LORD sent thunder, hail and fire running along the ground, and rained hail on the land of Egypt.
items.action: stretched forth his rod toward heaven; sent thunder, hail and fire; rained hail
items.mechanism: Divine action (thunder, hail and fire) that the narrative says followed Moses raising his rod. This is the text's own explanation, not a verified cause.
